# wallix-bastion_externalauth_kerberos (Resource)

Provides a Kerberos external authentication resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_externalauth_kerberos" "corporate" {
  authentication_name = "corporate_kerberos"
  host                = "kdc.corporate.local"
  ker_dom_controller  = "CORPORATE.LOCAL"
  port                = 88
  keytab              = filebase64("${path.module}/bastion.keytab")
  description         = "Corporate Kerberos realm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication_name` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `ker_dom_controller` (String)
- `port` (Number)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `kerberos_password` (Boolean)
- `keytab` (String, Sensitive)
- `login_attribute` (String, Deprecated)
- `use_primary_auth_domain` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Usage Notes

`ker_dom_controller` is the Kerberos realm name (typically the domain name in uppercase).
`keytab` is the base64-encoded keytab file content used to authenticate the Bastion against the
KDC. `kerberos_password` forces creation of a new resource if changed (`ForceNew`).

`login_attribute` is deprecated and no longer used - remove it from existing configurations.

## Import

Kerberos external authentication can be imported using the authentication name, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_externalauth_kerberos.corporate corporate_kerberos
```
